svg.title: Figure 04 · Repeated-run coverage and root mean squared error
svg.desc: 600 independent experiments per sample size; seed 1002. Coverage itself is noisy: at 95%, its binomial standard error with 600 repetitions is about 0.89 percentage points. No monotonic convergence of an individual run is implied.
